## Objective
- Build a complete, playable game inspired by *Car Parking Multiplayer*.

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport ≤1280px); read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a single-player precision-parking game, “Lot Legends,” with a free-roam parking lot and Bay 24 as the objective.
- Added keyboard and touch driving controls, parking scoring, collision feedback, minimap, sound toggle, and responsive layouts.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game interface and canvas-based driving game in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- `node --check game.js` passed.

  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
